author: XXPROFESION
quote: Unplayable on PS5 in its current state. The frame rate regularly drops as low as 5 fps and constantly jumps up and down, so the game keeps stuttering. Character faces and textures sometimes stay low-resolution and pixelated. My console is fine and every other game runs without issues. For a game marketed as "plays best on PS5", this performance is unacceptable. Sony also refused my refund because the game had been pre-loaded. Just wait for the PC version
